nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.ja-JP.md
nodes.summary: Japanese translation of the contributing guide for Hermes Desktop. Covers forking, installing dependencies, making changes, linting/typechecking, and submitting pull requests.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.md
nodes.summary: English contributing guide for Hermes Desktop. Describes the fork-and-PR workflow: install deps with npm, run dev mode, create branches, lint/typecheck before submitting, write clear PR descriptions, and reference issues.

nodes.name: CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md
nodes.summary: Simplified Chinese translation of the contributing guide for Hermes Desktop.

nodes.name: README.es-LATAM.md
nodes.summary: Latin American Spanish translation of the project README. Describes Hermes Desktop as a native desktop app for Hermes Agent with install instructions, features, and sponsor information.

nodes.name: README.ja-JP.md
nodes.summary: Japanese translation of the project README for Hermes Desktop.

nodes.name: README.md
nodes.summary: Main project README. Describes Hermes Desktop as a native Electron app for installing, configuring, and chatting with Hermes Agent. Covers install instructions (Windows/macOS/Linux/WSL), features (chat, sessions, profiles, memory, skills, tools, scheduling, gateways), keyboard shortcuts, developer setup, and sponsor (Atlas Cloud). Version 0.5.8, MIT licensed, by Nous Research.

nodes.name: README.zh-CN.md
nodes.summary: Simplified Chinese translation of the project README for Hermes Desktop.

nodes.name: dev-app-update.yml
nodes.summary: Development auto-update configuration for electron-updater. Points to the GitHub repo fathah/hermes-desktop with a custom updater cache directory name.

nodes.name: electron-builder.yml
nodes.summary: Electron Builder configuration for packaging Hermes One (appId: com.nousresearch.hermes). Defines build targets: Windows (NSIS + portable), macOS (notarized, hardened runtime, entitlements for camera/mic/docs/downloads), Linux (AppImage, snap, deb, rpm with SUID chrome-sandbox fix). Excludes source files from dist, unpacks better-sqlite3 native module. Publishes to GitHub.

nodes.name: electron.vite.config.ts
nodes.summary: Electron-Vite build configuration. Configures three build targets: main (externalizes better-sqlite3), preload (two entry points: index.ts and askpass.ts), renderer (path aliases, Three.js deduplication, Tailwind CSS and React plugins).

nodes.name: eslint.config.mjs
nodes.summary: ESLint flat config. Uses @electron-toolkit presets for TS and Prettier. Configures React, react-hooks, and react-refresh plugins. Ignores build artifacts, scripts, and .claude directory. Disables react/no-unknown-property for the office3d directory (Three.js intrinsic elements) and relaxes return type annotations there.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Project manifest for hermes-desktop v0.5.8. Scripts: dev, build (with typecheck), lint, test (vitest), platform-specific builds. Key dependencies: Electron 39, React 19, Three.js 0.183, @react-three/fiber 9, better-sqlite3, i18next, react-markdown, electron-updater, posthog-js, Tailwind CSS 4, TypeScript 5.9, Vitest 4.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Root TypeScript config. Contains no files of its own; references tsconfig.node.json and tsconfig.web.json as composite project references.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for Electron main/preload/shared code. Extends @electron-toolkit/tsconfig for Node. Includes main process, preload scripts, shared modules, and the electron-vite config file. Composite build with electron-vite/node types.

nodes.name: tsconfig.web.json
nodes.summary: TypeScript config for the renderer (web) code. Extends @electron-toolkit/tsconfig for web. Includes renderer source, shared modules, preload type declarations. Uses react-jsx transform, vitest globals, and path alias @renderer -> ./src/renderer/src.

nodes.name: vitest.config.ts
nodes.summary: Vitest test runner configuration. Uses jsdom environment, enables globals, passes with no tests, sets up @renderer and @shared path aliases, includes test files from src/ and tests/ directories, and uses a setup file at src/renderer/src/test/setup.ts.
